newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian levs closes firmer at 1,590-1,600 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian levs closes firmer at 1,590-1,600 to dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,590-1,600 per dollar, up from the opening near 1,610 and from 1,605-1,615 at the close on Friday due to higher foreign currency supply on the interbank market, dealers said.
"Foreign currency supply from clients and banks outweighed demand and the lev ended up 10 to 20 against the dollar from early levels," a dealer said.
The central bank was seen buying dollars at 1,595-1,596 levs in the afternoon, locking trade in a narrow range and averting a further lev rise, dealers said. Central bank officials declined comment.

The market was likely to be quiet on Tuesday with no sharp movements in the exchange rate as foreign currency supply was expected to remain high and the upside for the lev to be capped by the central bank, dealers said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
